regions.name: Xe Kaman
regions.quote: It occurs alongside numerous other fish species, and was recorded alongside Channa gachua, Devario gibber, Mastacembelus armatus, Monopterus albus, Rasbora paviana, and Rhinogobius taenigena at one locality in the Xe Kaman river system, Laos, for example.
